description: This file defines the class StreamPerPartitionDataAdapter, a specialized data adapter for EventHub streams in Orleans, providing methods to get stream positions and partition GUIDs.

classes.name: StreamPerPartitionDataAdapter
classes.description: A data adapter for EventHub streams, handling stream position retrieval based on partition and EventData.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Returns the StreamPosition for a given partition and EventData message, constructing a stream ID and sequence token.

methods.name: GetPartitionGuid
methods.description: Generates a GUID for a partition string by hashing and byte manipulation.
